title: Choose the visual world — steer: more senior partner
question: Steer applied: senior partner gravity. The roll assigned Partner Table (grounded #6). Keep it, take a challenger, re-roll, or take the category standard.

options.label: Partner Table
options.lineage: two-chair advisory desk / shared problem surface / quiet deal room
options.thesis: The product is the conversation across one table — calm authority, shared artifacts, a meeting that feels like the work starting.
options.viewport: Warm low-lit field; brand as engraved nameplate scale; one partner-pitch headline; Calendly as the primary seat-at-the-table action; experience as documents laid across the grain below.
options.risk: Can read luxury-consultant generic if specifics (stack, outcomes, Istanbul) stay vague.

options.label: Stenberg Sheet
options.lineage: 1920s Stenberg cinema poster — scale, tilt, decisive type
options.thesis: Senior presence as poster-scale clarity — one face of the offer, one action, no soft filler.
options.case: Wins gravitas and memorability for a partner brand; fuses as huge type + decisive Calendly. Risk: too theatrical if the human voice softens.
options.viewport: Full-bleed decisive composition; name enormous; pitch in one band; Calendly as the only button-scale object.
options.risk: Poster energy can overpower bilingual/RTL calm.

options.label: Redline Pin-up
options.lineage: architecture critique wall — prints, tape, red pen
options.thesis: Partnership as rigorous review — the senior who marks the drawing and leaves you clearer.
options.case: Strong 'technical partner' identification; experience/services as annotated sheets. Warmer than lab worlds, clearer than luxury oak alone.
options.viewport: Paper wall field; brand as title block; headline as redline note; Calendly as stamped ACTION.
options.risk: Can feel academic-studio if CTAs stay quiet.

options.label: Coiled Tower
options.lineage: coiled earth ceramic tower — patient build
options.thesis: Long-term partnership as coils stacked in light — retainers and products built seam by seam.
options.case: Good metaphor for retainers/long-term work; softer on immediate Calendly conversion clarity.
options.viewport: Earthen field; name low and solid; headline about building over time; Calendly as next coil.
options.risk: Craft-pottery read may underplay software authority.

canonCard.label: Category standard
canonCard.thesis: Polished dark personal site: big name, short pitch, Book a call — what senior-dev portfolios usually ship.
canonCard.viewport: Dark hero, name, one sentence, sticky CTA, then sections.
